learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge of the fundamentals of current factory organizations
Knowledge of the basic technologies of production automation and digitalization
Classification of the keyword "Industrie 4.0", its implementation possibilities and its critical questioning
Understanding of the essential principles behind the concepts of a "Factory of the Future"
Students can grasp the potential and complexity of future-oriented production scenarios.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of production, especially in the context of automation
Requirements of the factory/production for production automation
Concepts of the factory of the future
Worldwide Activities (Advanced Manufacturing, Industrie 4.0, Intelligent Manufacturing, e-Factory,...)
The human factor in digitized industry
Process monitoring as an essential component in the automation of networked production systems. Sensors, monitoring strategies up to teleservice
Integration of Deep- and Machine-Learning in production strategies
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
